text: The disputed point was whether B-0428 (sessions working B-0380 repeatedly ending "other"/stalled) needs further product-code work. It is overruled as moot: the root cause is that the heartbeat protocol asks every session to start a detached `nohup` background push as its first command, and this harness's own permission layer refuses that exact command — reproduced directly in this session, whose own first-command heartbeat start was denied the same way. A live session with no successful beat was killed as "stalled: no beat" even while its job log showed real progress, which is what hit B-0380's sessions three times and then hit this very item's own prior sessions twice (filed as B-0442). That failure mode is already fixed upstream by F-0265 (commit 242a9c5c, PR #935: "a local run whose job log is fresh is never stalled for a missing beat"), landed on `main` and already present at this branch's base — no edit on `fix/B-0428` makes it any more fixed. A 2026-10-07 groom pass already ruled this symptom class (a card counting "stalled" deaths) belongs on F-0265's acceptance, not a card of its own (see F-0270, removed on that basis); B-0428 is the same pattern one level down (B-0380's sessions instead of the whole fleet) and gets the same ruling. Nothing changes in the product; B-0428 closes as superseded.
